description: date-time-parser-layout-styles.md's own Go-syntax section header reads 'flexiblego and sanitizedgo date/time layouts use the following syntax', naming a fourth layout style, sanitizedgo, alongside the Go-standard and flexiblego styles the page actually documents. sanitizedgo never appears as a row in the page's main Layout Style comparison table and is never mentioned again anywhere else on the page - a named but undefined value.
